== deinterlace-yadif=send_field
(no invocation)
error: deinterlace "yadif=send_field" emits one frame per FIELD, which would double the output's frame count: refusing to encode. Packet-count parity and duration parity are graded against the SOURCE's frame count, so such an output could only be accepted by weakening a gate that stands in front of the deletion of a source

== encode-profile/matched
-hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -y -vaapi_device /dev/dri/renderD128,connection_type=drm -i <fixtures>/sdr.mkv -map 0 -map -0:d? -c copy -c:v h264_vaapi -color_range tv -fps_mode passthrough -vf format=nv12,hwupload -qp 30 -f matroska -max_muxing_queue_size 128 -muxing_queue_data_threshold 52428800 -thread_queue_size 8 -- <out>/film.mkv

== encode-profile/to-svtav1
-hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i <fixtures>/sdr.mkv -map 0 -map -0:d? -c copy -c:v libsvtav1 -pix_fmt yuv420p10le -color_range tv -fps_mode passthrough -preset 6 -crf 22 -f matroska -max_muxing_queue_size 128 -muxing_queue_data_threshold 52428800 -thread_queue_size 8 -- <out>/film.mkv
== encode-profile/to-cpu
-hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i <fixtures>/sdr.mkv -map 0 -map -0:d? -c copy -c:v libx265 -pix_fmt yuv420p10le -color_range tv -fps_mode passthrough -preset slow -crf 26 -x265-params log-level=error -f matroska -max_muxing_queue_size 128 -muxing_queue_data_threshold 52428800 -thread_queue_size 8 -- <out>/film.mkv
